architectural_notes: App flow: Splash page -> Internet Identity login -> main screen (calendar + chat).
known_issues: After Internet Identity login and clicking past the splash page, the app gets stuck on an infinite loading screen instead of navigating to the main calendar + chat screen; no browser console errors are shown.

existing_features.title: Fix the post-login navigation/loading flow so that after the user logs in and proceeds past the splash page, the app renders the main calendar + chat screen instead of getting stuck on a full-screen "Loading..." spinner.

Add explicit, user-visible error handling for the authentication gate so that if profile initialization (current user profile fetch) or actor initialization fails or stalls, the UI shows an English error state with a clear recovery action (e.g., retry and/or reload) instead of silently remaining on the loading screen.

projectName: Fix post-login infinite loading and ensure calendar + chat main screen renders after splash
